reason: I'm a deal hunter who prices every AI tool per seat and jumps to free tiers; $30 a seat a month is too much for an unproven shared layer when my agents already have free options, and I can't force my whole team onto one tool anyway.
objection: My team runs different agents; I can't force them all onto one shared layer, and at $30 per seat I'd pay for humans who may never adopt it.
would_change_my_mind: A free team-wide pilot (beyond 5 humans) that proves cross-agent context sharing works with zero config before I pay.
